topic: Optimal Wordle Strategies: An Algorithmic Approach
target_audience: University students with basic computer science or probability knowledge

sections.title: The Core Mechanism: Entropy in Information Theory
lecture_lines: Wordle is about maximizing information gain.
Each guess is a tool to gather info.
Think of the word pool as possibilities.
A good guess splits the search tree.
We want to narrow candidates effectively.

lecture_lines: We use entropy for information gain.
Aim for a balanced tree structure.

sections.title: Strategy 1: Frequency Analysis (The 'Vowel-Heavy' Start)
lecture_lines: Frequency analysis guides the first move.
High-frequency letters prune the space faster.
Letters like E, A, R are priority.

lecture_lines: Balance letter identification with positional constraints.
